description: Find code smells in JavaScript or TypeScript and say where: long function, long parameter list, conditional on type (switch or if/else instanceof chain, or the same switch repeated), message chain, large class, feature envy, duplicated code and global instance (static getInstance). Each hit comes with its lines, the numbers that triggered it, Fowler's refactoring name, the design pattern that usually resolves it with a live before/after demo, and a practice entry that says when NOT to refactor — pass its id to practice_check. These are HINTS from fixed, stated thresholds, not verdicts: a long function can be a table that reads fine. Parses with Lezer, so half-pasted code still gets analysed (`syntaxErrors` says the result may fall short). Accepts a file PATH, so a big file does not have to go through your context. Nothing is executed.

code.description: The source, JS or TS. Alternative to `path`

name: code_smells
